propositions: The Cloud rate-limit sweep's file list is hardcoded in _step0_names() rather than derived, so a transport module added to adapters/jira/ would not be swept unless manually added to the list.
Classified mutating methods can be renamed or moved to unswept sibling modules (backend.py, acli_subprocess.py, jira_fields.py) without the completeness assertion detecting the drift.
Option B implements an anti-drift guard that scans unswept modules for names in _CLASSIFIED_MUTATING and accepts only pure same-name self.transport delegations with unchanged arguments.
The four transport-surface modules must remain an explicit named constant (_SWEPT_TRANSPORT_MODULES) to keep the sweep scoped to the transport layer, not broadened to the entire package via glob.
Currently exactly two definitions outside swept modules collide with _CLASSIFIED_MUTATING (backend.py::set_relationship and backend.py::add_comment), both pure delegations that pass the guard.
